title: VANDIRA ECI Actual Data Ingestion & Normalization Contract
purpose: Discover and normalize official ECI election resources into a queryable evidence layer without mutating canonical local election/booth JSON.
quality_rules: Do not convert a 2024 Lok Sabha assembly-segment dataset into a 2024 Assembly election result.
Every normalized item keeps its official source URL and retrieval timestamp.
Transient backend download URLs are not persisted as permanent source-of-truth URLs.
Failed or partial retrieval is represented as a data-quality flag, not silently omitted.
Duplicate URLs are collapsed without merging conflicting source metadata.
